environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with AWS WAF WebACL. The IAM role attached to the ECS task has a policy with dynamodb:PutItem and dynamodb:Query but with a condition key `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` restricting access to items where PK matches `TENANT#${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}`. Additionally, the ALB target group has a request timeout of 5000ms and the WAF WebACL includes a rate-based rule (threshold: 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP) and a size constraint rule that blocks request bodies exceeding 1024 bytes. The Node.js process has --max-old-space-size=256 and the container has a 512MB memory limit with OOM kill enabled.

config.load_balancer: ALB with target group deregistration_delay=5s, request_timeout=5000ms
config.iam_policy: Allow dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:Query on arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:222222222222:table/user-content WITH Condition: ForAllValues:StringEquals dynamodb:LeadingKeys ['TENANT#${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}']
waf_rules: Rate-based rule: 100 requests/5min per source IP (action: BLOCK)
